title: Chocolate!
body: What will the following code output? Format your answer in the same way you expect Python to output the result of running the following code.\n##figure1.gif

figureAlts.figure1.gif: A code snippet using a for loop with variable c iterating over np.arange(5). If c is less than 2, it prints "Chocolate?". If c is even, it also prints "Yes sir! With or without nuts?". Otherwise, if c is odd, it prints "Again!?", and if not, it prints "CHOCOLATE" followed by a number of exclamation marks determined by the expression (c * 2 - 3).
